notes.text: Today we will explore how AI discovers matrix multiplication algorithms. We will first build some intuition about the hardware cost of addition and multiplication, then compare the direct method, Strassen and AlphaTensor on the same 4×4 inputs. We will examine how the 47-term algorithm modulo 2 scales recursively and how operation counts relate to runtime.
notes.action: Introduce the topic in about 15 seconds, then advance.
notes.sourceText: 今天以 AI 算法发现为主线。先用硬件建立加法与乘法的成本直觉，再用同一组 4×4 输入比较直接法、Strassen 与 AlphaTensor。重点是 47 次模 2 方案怎样递归服务更大的矩阵，以及为什么乘法次数优势仍不能直接等同于运行时间优势。

notes.text:
A transistor acts as a voltage-controlled switch. The diagram shows the gate, insulating oxide, source, drain and silicon substrate. At low gate voltage, the nMOS channel has not formed. A sufficiently high gate voltage creates a conducting channel through the electric field. The oxide electrically separates the gate from the silicon.
This is a simplified planar nMOS cross-section. Highlighted paths show voltage or signal changes. We will use the same small device diagrams and connecting wires to explain storage and addition.
notes.action: Toggle the switch and point out the channel appearing between source and drain.

只解释晶体管这个电控开关。图中保留栅极、绝缘层、源漏和硅衬底。输入低电平时，nMOS 导电通道未形成；输入提高到足够高的电平时，栅极电场让下方形成通道。栅极与硅之间有绝缘层，不能把栅极画成直接往通道灌电的导线。
这是平面 nMOS 的简化剖面。发光表示电平或信号变化，不是电子轨迹，也不是工艺版图。后面仍用这种物理剖面小图，加上实际的连接线路来解释存储与加法。
notes.sourceAction: 点切换开关，观察通道从断开到导通。只需记住：电压可以控制一个微型开关。

notes.text:
Two transistor groups are connected through feedback to hold one state. When storing 1, side A is high and side B is low. When storing 0, side A is low and side B is high. Together, these complementary states encode a single stored bit.
The diagram shows device cross-sections and connecting wires. Highlighted paths indicate high voltage. A complete storage cell combines several transistors, and retaining the state requires power.
notes.action: Show the stored 1 and then the stored 0. Explain the two stable states of one storage cell.
notes.sourceText:
2组晶体管互相连接，作为一个整体，用于固定一个状态。
下面只展示存储1和存储0两个稳定状态。存储1时，A侧是高电平1，B侧是低电平0；存储0时，A侧是0，B侧是1。两侧不是两个独立的存储位，而是互相连接，共同形成一个保存一位数据的整体。
图中保留晶体管剖面和连接线路，亮色表示高电平。不要把单个晶体管当作完整存储单元。状态保持需要供电。
notes.sourceAction: 先展示存储1，再点击存储0，对照两边电平的变化。用一个整体、两个稳定状态来讲清楚。

notes.text:
Registers store the operands, while the adder performs the arithmetic. A and B each hold four bits. Initially both contain 0011, or decimal 3. Wires carry their stored values to the addition circuit below.
Start at the least significant bit. The first bit computes 1+1+0=2, writes 0 and carries 1. The next computes 1+1+1=3, writes 1 and carries 1. The next computes 0+0+1=1 and carries 0. The most significant bit writes 0. The result is 0110, or 6. The animation then highlights the result storage. Reading A and B preserves their values.
Switch to 7+1 to show the carry chain producing 1000, or 8. The sequential animation explains carry propagation. Actual circuits may use other carry structures. The blocks simplify the internal transistor connections. Four-bit width and a matrix's 4×4 dimensions describe different things.
notes.action: Play 3+3. Point out the rightmost result bit and carry. Use 7+1 if time permits.
notes.sourceText:
先区分两个职责：寄存器用存储电路保存操作数，运算单元里的加法电路执行运算。动画中A和B各保存四位，默认都为0011，也就是十进制3。存储单元仍画为多组晶体管，连接线把它们的输出送到下面的加法单元。
先把两个数送入电路，再从最低位往高位解释：1+1+0=2，当前位写0，向左进1；下一位1+1+1=3，写1进1；再下一位0+0+1=1，写1不进位；最高位写0。四位结果为0110，也就是6。动画最后会亮起保存结果的存储组。读出操作数不会把原寄存器清空。
可切换7+1，观察连续进位得到1000，也就是8。逐位顺序只用于解释进位，不是现代处理器实际必须执行这些独立指令。图中加法单元用晶体管小图加功能框表示，省略全部器件接法；框外显示数据与进位的真实功能连接，实际器件数量和版图取决于实现。位宽四位与矩阵4×4的尺寸是不同概念。
notes.sourceAction: 播放一次3+3，重点指出右侧最低位的0与向左的进位；再按需要切换7+1。

notes.text:
Both 2+2 and 2×2 produce 4, but their general-purpose circuits have different internal structures. The four-bit representation of the input 2 is 0010. Registers store the operands and the arithmetic circuit processes them.
A general four-bit adder can produce up to five result bits when the final carry is retained. Here it displays 00100. The multiplier forms four partial products, 00000000, 00000100, 00000000 and 00000000. Aligning and combining them gives 00000100. Five and eight bits are the possible output widths of the general circuits. The value 4 itself needs only three bits.
With equal operand widths and comparable design goals, a general integer adder usually requires fewer circuit resources. That motivates algorithms which exchange some extra additions for fewer multiplications. Partial products are internal values and may be handled without allocating separate program registers.
A compiler can evaluate a constant expression in advance or implement multiplication by 2 as a shift. GPUs also have specialized floating-point fused multiply-add hardware. Timing depends on the implementation.
notes.action: Point out that both sides produce 4, then play the data paths and compare their structures.
notes.sourceText:
这页用2+2=4和2×2=4，让听众先看见输入相同、最终数值结果也相同，再对比通用电路的内部结构。输入2按四位写为0010。寄存器负责存数，运算单元负责计算。
通用四位加法电路求和与进位，结果完整保留进位时最多五位；本题结果显示00100，即4。通用四位乘法电路可展开为四行部分积：00000000、00000100、00000000、00000000，移位对齐合并后显示00000100，同样是4。最多五位与最多八位描述通用电路的结果宽度，不表示数值4本身需要五位或八位。
教学重点是：相同的数值答案，不要求相同的计算结构。在同位宽和相近设计目标下，通用整数加法通常使用更少电路资源，因而值得研究用一些加法换取更少乘法。部分积属于内部数据，不一定占用多个程序寄存器。
这个例子展示通用电路结构，不能证明固定算式2×2实际耗时更长。编译器可能直接把常量算式求值为4，或者把乘2转成移位。现代GPU的浮点乘加还有专用硬件，真实速度需要结合实现测量。
notes.sourceAction: 先指出两边都得到4，再播放数据路径。总结：结果相同，通用电路结构与资源开销仍可能不同。

notes.text:
All matrix examples use 4×4 inputs. Although these entries are 0 and 1, this first page uses ordinary arithmetic. The first row times the first column gives 1×1+0×0+1×1+1×1=3. Combining four products needs three additions.
There are 16 output entries, each requiring four multiplications and three additions. The totals are 64 multiplications and 48 additions. Later, all three algorithms will compute modulo 2 and use 64, 49 and 47 scalar multiplications respectively.
notes.action: Demonstrate the four products and three additions for the top-left entry, then show the full result.
notes.sourceText:
全场矩阵案例统一从 4×4 开始。这里 A 和 B 都只含 0 和 1，但这一页先按普通算术相乘，不取模。第一行与第一列计算为 1×1+0×0+1×1+1×1=3。四个乘积只需要三次加法合并。
输出有 16 格，每格 4 次乘法、3 次加法，所以总计 64 次乘法和 48 次加法。后面的三算法动画会在模 2 条件下比较 64、49、47 次乘法，并最终得到相同结果。
notes.sourceAction: 只示范左上格的四乘三加，再点看完整结果，快速建立64次基线。

notes.text:
The preceding 4×4 example used ordinary arithmetic. This slide takes the top-left entries of the same A and B to form an independent 2×2 example and switches to modulo-2 arithmetic. Input combinations and output sums are reduced modulo 2. These seven formulas match the notebook's S2 factors. Here a=1, b=0, c=0, d=1 and e=1, f=1, g=0, h=1. The full 4×4 top-left output block also includes contributions from the other input blocks.
Under modulo 2, 1+1 becomes 0. The direct method needs eight scalar products. Strassen combines the inputs into seven products M1 through M7. Their values here are 0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0 and 1. The top-left result is M1+M4+M5+M7, giving (0+1+1+1) mod 2=1. The other entries are 1, 0 and 1, matching the direct calculation.
For a 4×4 problem, split A and B into 2×2 blocks. The outer rule requires seven block products, and each block product uses seven scalar multiplications. This gives 7×7=49. The later comparison follows the same outer-first, inner-second order as TERMS_49 in the notebook. Strassen also works in ordinary arithmetic, where some of these plus signs must be minus signs.
notes.action: Identify A and B, read the seven product values and work through C11. Then point to 7×7=49.
notes.sourceText:
上一页的 4×4 示例按普通算术计算；本页仍取那组 A、B 左上角的数字，组成独立的 2×2 小题，并改用模 2 运算。输入组合与输出合并时，相加后都对 2 取余。本页的七个公式与笔记本的 S2 模 2 因子逐项对应：A 的 a=1、b=0、c=0、d=1；B 的 e=1、f=1、g=0、h=1。这个小题的 C 不是完整 4×4 结果的左上块，因为完整结果还包含其他块的贡献。
模 2 下 1+1 得 0。直接计算四个输出共要八次标量乘法；Strassen 把输入先组合，形成 M1 到 M7 七个乘积。本例的值依次是 0、1、0、1、1、0、1。左上角为 M1+M4+M5+M7，得到 0+1+1+1 模 2 等于 1。其余三格得到 1、0、1，与直接计算一致。
推广到 4×4 时先分成 2×2 的块，再对外层七个组合各用内层七次标量乘法。后面的三算法对比页按外层优先、内层随后这一顺序走完 49 拍，与笔记本 TERMS_49 的 49 项顺序和值一致。这里的独立 2×2 数值例子只是解释七项规则，不是动画中的某一拍。Strassen 在普通算术中也成立，但那时公式里的部分加号须用减号，不能照搬这页的全部加号。
notes.sourceAction: 先指 A、B 的数字，再读七个 M 的结果，最后只详细算 C11，并指出 7×7=49。

notes.text:
Strassen provides a classical human-designed baseline. AlphaTensor uses reinforcement learning to search for matrix multiplication algorithms. The paper appeared in Nature in 2022.
A candidate rule specifies linear combinations of the inputs, products of those combinations, and the output positions receiving each product. The complete rule must reproduce matrix multiplication while reducing the number of products. A neural network helps identify promising moves, tree search explores continuations, and feedback improves the choices. A discovered rule applies to new inputs within its arithmetic setting.
notes.action: Explain the three stages from left to right.
notes.sourceText:
Strassen 是人设计的经典基线；AlphaTensor 尝试用强化学习帮助搜索新的矩阵乘法算法，论文发表于 2022 年 Nature。
寻找算法时，需要决定怎样线性组合输入、让组合后的数相乘，以及把中间乘积加到哪些输出。最终必须与矩阵乘法完全一致，同时希望乘法更少。可以把它理解成：神经网络判断哪些动作更有希望，树搜索往前探索，再用反馈不断改进选择。发现出来的是适用范围内通用的计算规则。
notes.sourceAction: 按从左到右的顺序解释三步，不需要介绍寄存器或神经网络结构。

notes.text:
Each term selects entries from A, sums them modulo 2 to obtain L, and separately combines entries from B to obtain R. It then computes p=L×R. Finally it adds p to the chosen output positions, reducing every update modulo 2. The fixed coefficient vectors u, v and w specify these selections. Each of the 47 terms has its own vectors.
Modulo 2 keeps the remainder after division by 2, so 1+1 becomes 0. The resulting cancellations make the complete identity work. The algorithm reduces scalar products while also requiring input and output additions. Next we will inspect term 2 from the notebook.
notes.action: Follow the three-stage diagram, then demonstrate the modulo-2 addition example.
notes.sourceText:
先建立完整路线：每项从 A 中选一些格相加对2取余，得到 L；从 B 中选一些格相加对2取余，得到 R；计算 p=L×R；最后把 p 按固定规则加到 C 的指定位置，每次更新再对2取余。u、v、w 就是这三张固定清单。47项各有不同的清单。注意 A 和 B 分别组合，并不是把两矩阵相加。
模2只保留余数，因此1+1变成0。这种抵消是后面公式成立的关键。我们少做的是乘法，不能忽略组合输入和合并输出的加法。接下来放大与 Notebook 一致的第2项。
notes.sourceAction: 沿流程图从左讲到右，先读模2例子，暂不展示求和符号。

notes.text:
A and B use the notebook inputs in row-major order. A small label 13 means row 1, column 3. In term 2, u selects A13, A22 and A23, giving L2=(1+1+1) mod 2=1. Vector v selects B21, B24 and B34, giving R2=(0+0+1) mod 2=1.
Two selected B entries contain 0. A coefficient of 1 selects a position regardless of the value stored there. These selection positions stay fixed when the algorithm processes a new pair of binary matrices.
notes.action: Point to the three purple cells in A, then the three green cells in B, including the two zeros.
notes.sourceText:
本例 A 和 B 都来自 alphatensor_demo.ipynb，按行排列。小角标13表示第1行第3列，不是第13个元素。第2项的u在A13、A22、A23为1，其余为0，得到L2=(1+1+1) mod2=1。v在B21、B24、B34为1，得到R2=(0+0+1) mod2=1。
绿色选中的两个0特别重要：系数为1只表示要读取那个位置，和位置上的数值是两回事。规则不因输入数值而改变。若换另一对二进制矩阵，这张取数清单仍然适用。
notes.sourceAction: 先指出A的三个紫色格，再指出B的三个绿色格，明确选中位置可以存0。

notes.text:
The previous slide formed two values. Now compute L2×R2=1×1=1. Vector w for term 2 selects C14 and C21, so the same product contributes to both positions. The multiplication is performed once.
This term provides a partial contribution to each output. All 47 terms together reconstruct the complete matrix. The fixed u and v vectors select input combinations, and w selects output destinations. Forming combinations and accumulating the contributions also cost work.
notes.action: Trace the arrows from L2 and R2 to p2, then follow the branch to the two outputs.
notes.sourceText:
上一页把两组输入各组合成一个数，现在只需要L2×R2=1×1=1。第2项的w在C14和C21为1，其余为0，因此这个乘积会被复用到两个输出，而不是再计算两次同样的乘法。
不应把复用理解成两次完整点积已经算好：一个项只是一些输出的部分贡献，整套47项才合成正确结果。u和v指定输入组合，w指定输出去向，三者都来自固定分解。输入组合、分配与合并仍然有成本。
notes.sourceAction: 沿箭头从L2、R2指向p2，再用分叉说明一个乘积有两个去向。

notes.text:
First inspect the actual accumulator after term 1. It multiplies A13 by B31. Both are 1, so its product 1 contributes to C11, C12 and C21. Term 2 then adds 1 to C14 and C21. C14 changes from 0 to 1. C21 changes from 1 to 0 because (1+1) mod 2=0. All other entries keep their previous values.
Only two terms have been evaluated. Intermediate entries can move away from the final target before later terms correct them. Modulo-2 addition lets contributions cancel as the complete factorization is accumulated.
notes.action: Compare the three matrices and explain the two orange entries C14 and C21.
notes.sourceText:
为解释抵消，先看第1项的真实累计值。第1项取A13和B31，两者都是1，乘积1写入C11、C12和C21。然后第2项向C14和C21各加1。C14从0变1；C21从1变0，因为(1+1) mod2=0。其余格不变。
此时只完成2项，矩阵仍是中间状态。不能要求每一步的输出都向最终数值单调靠近。模2加法允许后续项把前面贡献抵消，这是整套分解的代数作用。
notes.sourceAction: 对照三个矩阵，只逐个解释C14与C21两个橙色位置。

notes.text:
All 47 terms follow the same process, each with its own u, v and w. The numbered tiles show completed products. On the right, compare the current accumulator with the direct-method target. Jump to terms 1 and 2 to connect this view with the previous slide, then play or drag through the remaining terms.
The final rows are 1111, 1101, 0010 and 0010, matching the direct matrix product modulo 2. Orange identifies the current term's output positions. The fixed algorithm evaluates all 47 terms, including those whose product happens to be 0 for this input. The number of matching cells can decrease during accumulation.
notes.action: Select term 2, then show the full result. Play or drag through the sequence if time permits.
notes.sourceText:
47项重复同一计算流程，但每项有各自的u、v、w。左侧47个编号每完成一项亮一个，右侧显示累计矩阵和直接法目标。可以先跳到第1项和第2项核对上一页，再播放或拖动到47项。
最后四行是1111、1101、0010、0010，与直接矩阵乘法对2取余相同。每步橙色只表示本项会贡献到的位置；某项乘积为0时也会按固定规则计算，不能因为本例输入有0就改变算法的乘法计数。暂时匹配的格数不一定每步增加。
notes.sourceAction: 点击第2项对照上一页，再点击完整结果；时间充足时播放或拖动47项轨迹。

notes.text:
A fixed bilinear decomposition can be verified by expanding every output as a linear combination of a_i b_j products. There are 16 outputs, 16 entries of A and 16 entries of B, giving 4096 coefficient relationships. A target coefficient is 1 when the inner input indices match and the outer indices identify the current output. All other target coefficients are 0.
For a required term, C11 includes A12 B21 because both inner indices are 2. Term 39 contributes it once, so the actual and target coefficients are both 1. For a cancellation, C12 excludes A11 B31. Terms 7 and 13 each contribute it once, so (1+1) mod 2=0, matching the target. The notebook checks every sum Σ_r w_ro u_ri v_rj mod 2. All 4096 coefficients agree, proving the identity for every binary 4×4 input pair. In ordinary integer arithmetic, a coefficient of 2 survives, so these particular 47 factors require modulo-2 arithmetic.
notes.action: Explain the coefficient-1 example first, then the coefficient-0 cancellation, and finish with all 4096 checks.
notes.sourceText:
算对一组例子还不够。固定分解是双线性的，所以可以把所有输出展开为a_i b_j的线性组合。总共有16个输出、16个A输入和16个B输入，共4096个系数关系。目标系数是：输入A的列与B的行相同，并且外侧行列对应当前输出时为1，其余为0。
先看应该保留的项：C11 需要 A12 B21，内侧下标同为2；公开分解的第39项贡献一次，目标系数与实际系数都是1。再看应该抵消的项：C12 不需要 A11 B31，但第7项与第13项各贡献一次，模2合并后实际系数为0，与目标一致。Notebook检查每个Σ_r w_ro u_ri v_rj mod2是否等于目标系数，全部4096项均一致，因此这套规则对任意二进制4×4输入都正确。普通整数中系数2不会消失，所以特定47项不能原样用于普通整数乘法。
notes.sourceAction: 先用 C11 的 A12 B21 说明系数1如何保留，再用 C12 的 A11 B31 说明两个贡献如何抵消为0，最后回到4096项全检。

notes.text:
The earlier pages execute a discovered algorithm. Discovery starts with the complete matrix multiplication tensor T and uses a residual tensor S as the game state. A move chooses coefficient vectors u, v and w for one intermediate product. Subtracting their outer-product contribution produces the next residual. Under modulo 2, subtraction and addition have the same effect. Reaching S=0 establishes a correct rule.
A neural network proposes moves and evaluates their promise. Tree search explores continuations. Reinforcement learning improves the choices through feedback and rewards correct solutions using fewer steps. The three nonzero counts show a replay of the published factors. The count can rise temporarily before reaching zero. The discovered 47-term result leaves open whether 46 terms are possible. Once the rule is available, new input matrices can use it directly.
notes.action: Explain the four search stages, then connect the fixed result to the following algorithm comparison.
notes.sourceText:
前几页是在执行已经找到的算法。这页解释发现阶段：把矩阵乘法全部系数关系写成目标张量T，以剩余张量S为游戏状态。一个动作选择三组系数u、v、w，对应一次中间乘法；扣除它的外积贡献，得到新状态。对模2来说，减法与加法相同。终点S全部为0时，得到一套正确的计算规则。
神经网络帮助建议动作并评估前景，树搜索探索后续，强化学习利用反馈改进选择；在正确前提下鼓励减少步骤。图中的三个剩余非零系数数量是公开分解的真实回放，不是浏览器训练，也不要求每步数量下降。47是发现的方案，不宣称证明不存在46项。规则找到后，面对新输入只需执行，不用每次重新搜索。
notes.sourceAction: 区分发现和执行，沿四个方框说明搜索目标；最后回到后续三算法动画。

notes.text:
All three columns use the same A and B. Purple and green highlight selected input entries. Orange identifies outputs receiving a contribution. Each frame represents one scalar multiplication.
The direct method accumulates row–column products. Strassen uses two recursive levels for 49 products. AlphaTensor executes the authors' 47-term factorization modulo 2. As in the notebook, each input combination is reduced before multiplication, and each output update is reduced afterwards. Frame 2 shows 1×1=1 and highlights C14 and C21.
AlphaTensor completes at frame 47, Strassen at 49, and the direct method at 64. Their final results agree. Additions, memory access and hardware costs are outside the animation's frame count. Actual elapsed time requires a benchmark.
notes.action: Single-step a few frames to explain the highlights, then run to completion. Allow about two minutes.
notes.sourceText:
这是同一道 4×4 题目，三列都使用相同的输入 A 和 B。紫色与绿色标出本步从 A 和 B 选取的数字，橙色标出本步贡献到哪些输出。每拍展示一次标量乘法。
直接算法按行乘列，逐项累加。Strassen 对输入进行分块组合，用两层递归完成 49 次乘法。AI 列使用作者公开的 47 项模 2 分解。与笔记本一致，AI 输入组合先对 2 取余，再相乘；输出矩阵每拍累计后也对 2 取余。第 2 拍可看到 1×1=1，并高亮 C14、C21。
动画到 47 步时 AI 路径结束，到 49 步时 Strassen 结束，到 64 步时直接算法结束。最后三种结果必须一致。加法、搬运与硬件开销没有按时间计入，所以不能把动画的结束先后当成实测运行速度。
notes.sourceAction: 先单步两三次，解释输入高亮与输出贡献，再快速播放到终点。建议留约两分半。

notes.text:
The horizontal axis is square matrix size N. We use N=4^k so that a 4×4 rule can be applied recursively for k levels. Each level multiplies the number of scalar products by 64, 49 or 47. The totals are therefore 64^k, 49^k and 47^k. The vertical axis normalizes the direct method to 100%.
At N=1024=4^5, the direct method uses 1,073,741,824 scalar multiplications. AlphaTensor uses 229,345,007, or about 21.36% of that count, a reduction of 78.64%. The corresponding exponents are approximately 2.778 for AlphaTensor, 2.807 for Strassen and 3 for the direct method.
These counts apply to the modulo-2 algorithms. Other sizes may require blocking or padding. Additions, memory traffic, constant factors and hardware still determine the runtime.
notes.action: Follow the axis from 4 to 1024, compare the three curves and explain the endpoint values.
notes.sourceText:
横轴是方阵大小 N，只取 N=4^k，便于把 4×4 算法递归应用 k 层。每层直接法把乘法数乘 64，Strassen 乘 49，AlphaTensor 的模 2 方案乘 47，所以总数分别为 64^k、49^k、47^k。纵轴把直接法设为 100%，观察另外两条线随矩阵变大而下降。
例如 N=1024=4^5：直接法需要 1,073,741,824 次标量乘法，AlphaTensor 需要 229,345,007 次，约为直接法的 21.36%，少 78.64%。论文将递归复杂度写为约 O(N^2.778)，优于 Strassen 的约 O(N^2.807) 与直接法 O(N^3)。
这是模 2 条件下的理论乘法计数。其他尺寸可通过分块或填充处理，但额外的模 2 加法、访存、常数项和硬件实现仍决定实际耗时。
notes.sourceAction: 沿横轴从 4 指到 1024，先比较三条线，再用 N=1024 的数字说明理论乘法优势如何累积；最后强调模 2 与非实测边界。

notes.text:
These counts use the same directly expanded implementation for all three methods. Input combinations are formed separately and their products are merged into outputs. The direct method uses 64 products, 0 input additions and 48 output additions. Flattened Strassen uses 49 products, 190 input additions and 128 output additions, totaling 318 additions. AlphaTensor uses 47 products, 202 input additions and 138 output additions, totaling 340.
Combining k selected inputs needs k−1 modulo-2 additions. Combining k contributions at one output also needs k−1 additions. Initial assignments are free in this model, and zero coefficients are skipped. Counts are fixed independently of the 0/1 input values. Classic recursive Strassen shares intermediate expressions and can use 198 additions, which is a different implementation.
Compared with flattened Strassen, AlphaTensor saves 2 products and adds 22 additions. If an addition costs 1 and a multiplication costs m, AlphaTensor is cheaper when m>11. Against the direct method, it saves 17 products and adds 292 additions, requiring m>292/17, about 17.18. At cost 20 the totals are 1328, 1298 and 1280. At cost 1 they are 112, 367 and 387. Hardware performance also depends on sharing, precision, memory access and specialized instructions.
notes.action: Compare fewer products with more additions, then select costs 1, 20 and 50 to show how the assumption changes the result.
notes.sourceText:
这里用统一的直接展开方式计数，所有三种算法都逐项计算输入线性组合，再合并输出，不共享额外的加法中间表达式。所有输出最终对 2 取余。直接算法64次乘法、0次输入加法、48次输出加法；Strassen展平49乘、190次输入加法、128次输出加法，总318；AlphaTensor47乘、202次输入加法、138次输出加法，总340。
计数规则是k个输入项相加需要k-1次模 2 加法，一个输出的k个贡献合并需要k-1次模 2 加法。首次赋值不算加法，零系数不执行操作。次数不随矩阵中0/1取值变化而消除操作。这些是当前统一展开实现的计数，不是论文宣称的最优加法数。经典递归Strassen可共享中间结果，得到198次加减法，那是另一个实现口径。
所以AI比展平Strassen少2次乘法，但多22次模 2 加法；乘法成本m、模 2 加法成本1时，需要m>11才在这个模型中更划算。相比直接算法，AI省17乘、多292次模 2 加法，需要m>292/17约17.18。成本20时三者为1328、1298、1280；成本1时为112、367、387。教学模型不等于GPU实测时间，实际要考虑共享优化、精度、访存与专用指令。
notes.sourceAction: 先解释乘法变少而模 2 加法增加，再点成本1、20、50，让听众观察不同假设会改变结论。

notes.text: The recursive chart counts scalar multiplications for large matrices. The cost slider gives assumed arithmetic units for one 4×4 implementation. To measure runtime, also include modulo-2 additions, registers, intermediate values, memory access, fused multiply-add instructions, matrix shape, precision and the implementation. Recursion accumulates theoretical savings, while the final timing depends on the target hardware and data type.
notes.action: Connect the recursive count and cost model to the hardware factors shown here.
notes.sourceText: 前面的大矩阵曲线统计递归后的标量乘法次数，上一页的成本滑块统计单层 4×4 方案的假设算术单位；它们都不是硬件实测加速比。实际要计入额外的模 2 加法、寄存器与中间结果、访存、融合乘加、矩阵形状、精度和实现。大矩阵让理论乘法优势累积，但是否更快仍需在目标硬件和目标数据类型上测量。
notes.sourceAction: 把大矩阵的理论曲线与本页的实现边界联系起来，避免把乘法数直接说成加速比。

notes.text:
The same computation can have different algorithms. Strassen and AlphaTensor reorganize the arithmetic to reduce scalar products. Recursion applies small algorithms to larger matrices, and implementation measurements evaluate their practical performance.
AI can participate in discovering and optimizing fundamental algorithms. Comparing methods requires a clear arithmetic domain, problem size, operation-count convention and hardware measurement. Invite questions here.
notes.action: Pause after the conclusion and invite discussion about how to compare algorithms.
notes.sourceText:
回到开场问题：同一道计算题，即使答案固定，计算路径仍然可能改进。Strassen 和 AlphaTensor 展示了重新组合步骤来减少乘法；递归让一个小矩阵算法服务更大的矩阵；成本模型提醒我们仍要测量实际实现。
今天最重要的结论是，AI 已经可以参与基础算法的发现与优化，而评价一种方法还需要明确数域、规模、运算计数与真实硬件表现。可以在这一页接受提问。
notes.sourceAction: 总结后停顿，邀请听众讨论怎样定义计算方法更好。
